subject: FinLytics evaluation kickoff — next steps & scheduling

Hi Alex / Maria,

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through FinLytics' use case today — really helpful context. Per our conversation, next logical step is a 60-minute evaluation kickoff where we can align on:
- trial plan & timeline (what you want to evaluate, dataset size)
- success criteria / metrics for the eval
- prompt set / eval harness and permissions
- technical deep dive + integration checklist (data ingest, auth, network)

Are you available for a kickoff this week or early next week? Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu 11/11, 10:00–11:00
- Thu 11/11, 14:00–15:00
- Fri 11/12, 09:00–10:00

I attached a short eval_plan.xlsx that outlines a suggested trial cadence and a draft SOW to speed procurement if we need it. Connor (cc) will join for the technical portion.

If those times don't work, tell me a couple that do and I'll coordinate.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. We want to make sure the kickoff covers both the business success criteria and the technical checklist. A couple quick items from our side: 
- Success criteria: latency under 250ms p95 for typical 512-token prompts, <20% drop in accuracy vs current baseline on our prompt set, and end-to-end integration with our event pipeline for embeddings.
- We need to involve our procurement lead for any SOW/discussions around committed capacity — cc'ing them now.

Of the slots you proposed, Thu 11/11 10:00–11:00 PT works best for us. Can you share a short agenda and the prompt set format ahead of time? Also, can your SE confirm what data samples we should prepare for the eval?

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Data Products | FinLytics
alex.johnson@finlytics.com

Thanks Alex — Connor here (Solutions Engineer). Confirming I'll join Thu 11/11 10:00–11:00 PT. For the technical portion, we'll plan for ~30 minutes to cover:
- test dataset format (sample JSONL with prompt/ground_truth, size guidance)
- ingestion options (S3 presigned, secure upload, API ingestion)
- auth & networking for Private/Dedicated options (VPC peering, firewall rules)
- expected runtime profiles and recommended quantization/configs for cost/latency

Please prepare a small sample of 200–500 prompts in the proposed format if possible (we can start smaller if needed). We can also share a checklist for IT/security ahead of the meeting (SOC2 report via secure link) — we'll avoid sending attachments over email.
